value_correctness.summary: SAR thousand. Verified (page-read): FY2025, FY2024 original, FY2023 original, FY2022 original (each with one comparative year) and H1 2026 (3M and 6M). Savola restates heavily and the restatements were found on the pages. (1) FY2024 as originally filed (de290fdc): revenue 23,986,655, results from operations 1,454,680, profit before zakat/tax 11,863,818, total liabilities 15,815,179, equity 5,579,063; re-presented in the FY2025 filing: revenue 23,045,574, results from operations 1,385,563, PBT 11,936,679, liabilities 15,825,605, equity 5,568,637 (discontinued operations re-presented; loss from discontinued ops (1,381,990) -> (1,440,202); profit 9,915,352 unchanged). (2) FY2023 original: revenue 26,818,317, CFO 1,719,969, total assets 29,962,663; re-presented in the FY2024 filing: revenue 24,149,521, CFO 1,539,364, total assets 29,937,138 (profit 1,070,476 unchanged). (3) FY2022 original: CFO 1,104,571, results from operations 1,701,586; re-presented in the FY2023 filing: CFO 1,029,420 and 1,667,866. Whichever filing is taken for a year changes revenue, operating profit and CFO; both versions are transcribed. Continuing vs discontinued: FY2025/FY2024 statements show a continuing block plus a separate discontinued line, and EPS has continuing and total variants (FY2025 2.95 / 2.93; FY2024 restated 12.08 / 10.61). FY2024 profit includes a one-off gain of 11,554,662 on distribution of an equity-accounted investee. H1 2026: quarter and cumulative income columns, cash flow cumulative only. Cash-flow closing cash (842,697 at 31 Dec 2025) differs from balance-sheet cash (904,137) as printed (term-deposit / overdraft definitions); the roll includes the printed FX line.
